_note: This file is a pure MMDetection3D configuration file. It contains only variable assignments (dicts, lists, conditionals) with no functions, classes, or callable APIs. No CLI entry point exists. Examples below describe how the config is used by the framework.
configure_imvoxelnet_model: configure an ImVoxelNet model with ResNet50 backbone, FPN neck, and ScanNetImVoxelHeadV2 for 3D object detection
configure_train_pipeline: configure the training data pipeline with MultiViewPipeline loading 50 random images per scene
configure_test_pipeline: configure the test data pipeline with MultiViewPipeline loading 101 images per scene
configure_scannet_dataset: configure the ScanNetMultiViewDataset for training, validation, and test splits with 18 object classes
configure_training_hyperparameters: configure AdamW optimizer with lr 0.0002, step LR policy, and 12 total epochs
